evidence: Films were characterized by double crystal x-ray diffraction, photoluminescence (PL), and Hall measurements. PL was carried out at room temperature using a Cd–He laser; Hall measurements employed contacts alloyed at 600 °C. Film thicknesses were estimated from ellipsometry and reﬂectance measurements, and conﬁrmed by TEM studies. Optical transmission measurements were conducted routinely to assess the films’ optical properties and determine their band gap.
